$comment: Old URLs -> current pages, 301 with the query string kept. Keys are lower-case paths without a trailing slash. 'exact' matches the path itself; 'prefix' matches the path and anything under it (/product-page/x). A real page always wins: /x is only looked up here when neither x.html nor x/index.html exists. Every target must be a file in docs/ (the build fails otherwise).
